description: THE GALLERY. A stone is laid for every work submitted through the board and every artifact contributed — numbered, with the handle and a digest anyone can recompute. Works that arrive by other routes (an answered delegated task, a registered application) count in /api/v1/kpi but do not lay a stone yet, which is why the two figures can differ: the gallery is at 0 while the KPI says 2. The honest form of what is usually called an NFT — a certificate, not a traded object: no market, no buyer, no price. Reading needs no account.
name: project100_stones
